query:
SELECT 
  c.orderIndex,
  c.sectionType,
  LEFT(c.content, 80) as content_preview
FROM content_sections c
JOIN scraped_pages p ON c.pageId = p.id
JOIN scraping_jobs j ON p.jobId = j.id
WHERE j.id = 90007
ORDER BY c.orderIndex
LIMIT 25
